Food Processing Food ingredients Animal Feed & Supplements Aggregates Pharmaceutical Laundry Furniture & Bedding Pioneers in packaging for over 50 years Since Hanmere was founded, innovation has been our core value as polythene manufacturers in the UK. From our work alongside raw material manufacturers to our more recent developments in our own proprietary blends, designed to strengthen and lighten traditional polymers, Hanmere has been a part of reinventing how polythenes are used in the UK and further. For our clients, we offer the expertise of our years of experience which combined with our strong ties with industry associations ensures our customers benefit from our professional advice. Find out more Why choose Hanmere? With Hanmere, your business benefits from a personalised service. We are able to offer a wide range of polythene products to suit every sector, all manufactured in the UK to the high standards of a BRCGS certification and M&S Approved supplier. Our audits are designed to recommend and specify the correct product for the application, often lighter, more environmentally friendly and a cost efficient solution.
